question: Could you assess the relationship between the poverty rates from the previous year's census data and the percentage of births without maternal morbidity for the years 2016 to 2018? Use only data for births where no maternal morbidity was reported and for each year, use the 5-year census data from the year before to compute the Pearson correlation coefficient
sql:
WITH natality AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM Year) as yr,
    County_of_Residence_FIPS,
    SUM(Births) as total_births,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Maternal_Morbidity_YN = 1 THEN Births ELSE 0 END) as no_morbidity_births
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_cdc_wonder_natality.county_natality_by_maternal_morbidity`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM Year) IN (2016, 2017, 2018)
  GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM Year), County_of_Residence_FIPS
),
census_2015 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) as poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2015_5yr`
  WHERE pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
),
census_2016 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) as poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2016_5yr`
  WHERE pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
),
census_2017 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) as poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2017_5yr`
  WHERE pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
),
joined AS (
  SELECT 
    n.yr,
    CASE n.yr 
      WHEN 2016 THEN c2015.poverty_rate
      WHEN 2017 THEN c2016.poverty_rate
      WHEN 2018 THEN c2017.poverty_rate
    END as poverty_rate,
    n.no_morbidity_births * 100.0 / n.total_births as pct_no_morbidity
  FROM natality n
  LEFT JOIN census_2015 c2015 ON n.County_of_Residence_FIPS = c2015.geo_id
  LEFT JOIN census_2016 c2016 ON n.County_of_Residence_FIPS = c2016.geo_id
  LEFT JOIN census_2017 c2017 ON n.County_of_Residence_FIPS = c2017.geo_id
  WHERE n.total_births > 0
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    yr,
    COUNT(*) as n,
    SUM(poverty_rate) as sum_x,
    SUM(pct_no_morbidity) as sum_y,
    SUM(poverty_rate * pct_no_morbidity) as sum_xy,
    SUM(poverty_rate * poverty_rate) as sum_x2,
    SUM(pct_no_morbidity * pct_no_morbidity) as sum_y2
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY yr
)
SELECT 
  yr,
  ROUND((n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) / SQRT((n * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x) * (n * sum_y2 - sum_y * sum_y)), 6) as pearson_r
FROM stats
ORDER BY yr
